title: Vaishnavism Saints Vallabhacharya
definition: Vallabhacharya (1479–1531) was a prominent Telugu philosopher and the founder of the Pushtimarg (Path of Grace) sect of Vaishnavism, emphasizing pure non-dualism (Shuddhadvaita) and devotion to Lord Krishna.
importanceInUpsc: UPSC frequently tests the Bhakti movement's philosophical nuances, specifically the distinction between various schools of Vedanta (Advaita, Vishishtadvaita, Shuddhadvaita) and the regional spread of Krishna-bhakti.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Vaishnavism Saints Vallabhacharya.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Overview of the Bhakti movement in Medieval India
